content: Vercel KV is deprecated/sunset (auto-migrated to Upstash Redis Dec 2024); the current path for provisioned Redis on Vercel is the Vercel Marketplace 'Upstash for Redis' integration (or a direct Upstash account), which injects REST URL/token env vars and pairs with @upstash/ratelimit for edge-compatible rate limiting. Upstash free tier: 500K commands/month. Not required at this project's traffic scale; documented as the upgrade path, not the MVP default.
